An admission auction typically sells 100 identity slots per epoch by sealed bid, turning bulk forgery into a competitive cost.

Each bid locks a deposit for 3 epochs; a shale of forged bids is exposed in funding graphs, and a challenge burns the bid while honest losers are refunded minus 2%.

At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 identities cost 60,000; a zephyr of demand doubles the price, so a wander of 10,000 forged identities costs 1,000,000.
